objective.text: Route to an invokable controller through its class rather than an invented action name.

difficulty.rationale: Route a single-action controller without assuming an index method exists.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: RebuildPreviewController has a public __invoke() action and no index(), handle(), or show() method. Which registration invokes its single action for POST /preview?

options.rationale: Laravel recognizes the invokable controller class and uses __invoke as its action.
This is not valid PHP syntax for naming or constructing the intended route action.
options.misconception: This is not valid PHP syntax for naming or constructing the intended route action.

options.rationale: No index method exists on this controller.
options.misconception: No index method exists on this controller.

options.rationale: handle is a different convention used elsewhere; it is not present here.
